## What's new

### 📅 Pick the date in Activity
- Adding or editing a transaction now has a **Date** field. It starts at today (or the existing date when editing), and you can go back as far as you need or up to a year ahead for bills you know are coming.
- Editing a transaction now saves the date you choose. Before, edits always kept the original date.

### 🎯 Weekly budgets work
- **Weekly** budgets now count this week's spending (Monday to Sunday). Before, every budget was measured against the whole calendar month.
- Each budget card shows the period it covers, like *This week · Sep 21 – 27* or *This month · September*.
- The assistant's budget answers use the same calculation, so they match the Budgets screen.

## Download
- **`PocketSense-v1.2.2-arm64-v8a.apk`**: almost all modern Android phones. Use this one if unsure.
- `PocketSense-v1.2.2-armeabi-v7a.apk`: older 32-bit phones
- `PocketSense-v1.2.2-x86_64.apk`: emulators and Chromebooks

Installs as an update over v1.2.1. If you're coming from a build older than v1.2.1, see the [v1.2.1 notes](https://github.com/software-ace/PocketSense/releases/tag/v1.2.1) for the one-time reinstall.
